 Updated: 12:32 AM EST Nov 4, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Carrie Hodgin GUILFORD COUNTY, N.C. — Voters in Guilford County are deciding on several races, including the Guilford County Schools Board of Education, Guilford County Board of Commissioners, and the Guilford County Sheriff's race, among sales tax and referendums. 
 Here are the latest election results for Guilford County.
